title: Worship out of Love: From Habit to the Heart (10-12 years)
description: A path to help parents guide their son from performing 'ibadah out of habit to loving it with the heart, at an age when some children reach puberty and others are approaching it: Salah with love, the first fasts, a living relationship with the Qur'an, and du'a as intimate conversation.

primary_reference.info: Tarbiyat al-Awlad fi al-Islam (Raising Children in Islam) by Abdullah Nasih Ulwan + Manhaj al-Tarbiyah al-Nabawiyyah lil-Tifl (The Prophetic Method of Raising the Child) by Muhammad Nur Suwayd
